Anomaly Arbitration

Anomaly Arbitration is a series of extremely difficult challenges. In Anomaly Arbitration, you will play against powerful enemies to bring equilibrium back to the world. Each period of Anomaly Arbitration will feature 3 Knight stages and 1 King stage. Protected by the Knight stages, the King's strength will be greatly enhanced, making it difficult to defeat. Completing the 3 Knight stages will ret…

Enemy Traits

In Anomaly Arbitration, enemy materializations will have slight differences between them and regular enemies. Trailblazers can check out the details by reading about the enemies' traits when the battle begins.

Arbitral Quadrant

After each period of Anomaly Arbitration updates, several Arbitral Quadrant buff effects will be added to each King's challenge. Before challenging the King, you can choose one of these buff effects for the team.

Cycles

In Anomaly Arbitration, every battle in the stage has its own independent Cycle limit. If the limit is exceeded during a challenge, it will be considered a failure. Clearing the battle within the designated number of Cycles and fulfilling specific conditions will grant a star rating for that stage. In Anomaly Arbitration battles, the total action value of the first Cycle will be greatly increased,…

Knight Stages

The 3 Knight Stages must be challenged using 3 different character teams, and you can decide the order in which you challenge them. After completing each Knight Stage, a record of the team will be saved. King Stage

In each Period's Anomaly Arbitration, there is only 1 King Stage, which can be challenged with any team. It is recommended that you complete the Knight Stages first to restore the King Stage to its regular difficulty before challenging it.
